shared_elements: stylized frontal face or mask carved in relief
spiral/volute (scroll) motif, including a scroll-like eye
bulging rounded eyes and heavy brow forms
large-scale carved monument/boulder with figural relief
justification: Both surfaces depict massive stylized faces built from bulging rounded eyes and curling volute/scroll elements, and the spiral 'scroll eye' on the central block in B has a fair counterpart among the scrollwork masks of A. The decisive difference is organisation: A shows a dense, strictly vertical stack of superimposed masks, glyph-like panels and interlaced scrolls covering the whole shaft with a human figure at its base, whereas B shows single, isolated, sparsely carved head-forms on separate blocks with no stacked or panelled scheme.
